title: Kanan's Easy
overview: The devil Kanan has been cultivating humans to eat their souls... until one of them ends up as her boyfriend.

title: Ami Has Arrived
overview: Kanan's maid, Ami, has come to check on her and snack on all the cute humans.

title: Kanan's First Date
overview: After catching Kyougi with his old friend, Kanan finds the courage to ask him out on a date that goes awry.

title: Ami the Forceful Cupid
overview: Ami arranges all kinds of ploys to try and get Kanan and Kyougi to finally kiss.

title: Kanan and the Saint
overview: Jeanne, a saint, arrives from Heaven to protect Kyougi from devils but proves to be unintentionally seductive.

title: Kanan's First Time Skipping
overview: After some embarrassing events leave Kanan flustered, Kyougi skips school to take her on a beach date.

title: Kanan's Summer Break
overview: Kanan tutors Kyougi and Nadeko. Nadeko lusts for Kanan's scorn. All the girls shop for swimsuits together.

title: Kanan Returns to Her Family
overview: Kanan introduces Kyougi to her family, and they work on getting approval for their relationship.

title: Lilim's Test of Defeat
overview: Kyougi and Kanan learn how Lilim met Kanan's father, then Lilim tests their relationship with her seduction.

title: Milch's Bratty Memories
overview: Jeanne comes clean. Kyougi learns about Milch's true feelings.

title: Miel's Stolen Love
overview: Kyougi and Kanan take Miel to the lakeside with them to try and earn her stamp of approval.

title: Kanan and Kyougi's Trial of Love
overview: Kanan and Kyougi play beach volleyball to earn Beelzebub's final stamp of approval.
